decision: Select the information architecture for the final BidPilot authenticated submission experience.
population_label: Three Seed-design-system BidPilot product shells sharing the same backend and evidence contract.
order_policy: Seeded independent shuffle per lane and replica with identities removed.
disagreement_rule: Adjudicate when total range is at least 20 or any axis range is at least 8.
tie_rule: Prefer higher technical proof, then demo clarity, then lower judge variance.
pairwise_plan: Compare both finalist orientations in every lane and warn above 65 percent left-position wins.
source_locked_sensitivity_plan: Re-score using only directly observed artifact behavior.
parity_reconstructed_sensitivity_plan: Re-score the equal-length cards with the same rubric and no identity reveal.
unscoreable_policy: Exclude from idea ranking and report separately; never assign zero.
output_schema: Four integer axes from 0 to 25, one decisive reason, and evidence gaps.
